# Expected findings — test fixtures

Control set for evaluating the analysis agent. The table lists each planted
problem (exact sentence as written in the fixture) and the expected law area
only — no article numbers. Finding the exact articles is the agent's job, and
law article numbers must never be hardcoded in fixtures (GLOBAl_RULES.md,
working rule 3).
